cohort: 1463 females of reproductive age (18-40 years) who underwent CTPA for suspicion of PE
finding: The rate of CTPA positive for PE was significantly lower in pregnant women compared to nonpregnant and early postpartum women.
mod_finding: The study found that pregnant women had a lower rate of pulmonary embolism diagnosed by CTPA compared to both nonpregnant and early postpartum women.
